notes.title: Update 1.1.0 is here for K2: Digital Edition on Steam!
notes.content:
The brand-new [b]Avalanche [/b]mini expansion has arrived, bringing fierce weather and fresh challenges. 🌨️ And thanks to [b]Steam Cloud[/b], your progress follows you wherever you climb - from base camp to summit and back again. ☁️🧗

🏔️ While you’ve been scaling peaks, we’ve been fine-tuning the ropes behind the scenes. Check out the full changelog below to see what’s new, and what’s been fixed along the way.

[h3]Version 1.1.0[/h3]
[Feature] Prepare for even tougher climbs! The Avalanche mini expansion is now available, introducing new weather conditions to challenge your ascent.
[QoL] Your progress now travels with you! Automatically back up your saves with Steam Cloud.
[QoL] A new marker shows when a space on the mountain is fully occupied, helping you plan your route more clearly.
[QoL] You can now attach your last save file automatically when submitting a report, making it easier for us to investigate issues.
[Fix] Game now runs at a maximum of 60 FPS to prevent unnecessary GPU heating and reduce energy usage.
[Fix] Fixed an issue where the screen would jump while scrolling on touchscreen devices.

notes.title: Update 1.0.6 is here!
notes.content:
🚩 [b]K2: Digital Edition[/b] has just been updated - [b]version 1.0.6 is now live and ready to download on Steam[/b], bringing a fresh wave of improvements, fixes, and tweaks that enhance your gameplay. ⛏️

🏔️ We’ve been working hard over the past few days to bring you these updates, and below you can also find the changelog with the previous improvements we’ve made so far:
[h3]Version 1.0.6[/h3]
[QoL] Improved the rulebook for better clarity.
[QoL] Added extra onboarding popups explaining rule modifications.
[QoL] Added an indicator/marker when a space is over-occupied.
[Fix] Fixed a bug where the camera could point into the sky.
[Fix] Fixed various typos.

[h3]Version 1.0.5[/h3]
[Fix] Adjusted the description for the “DeathZone” achievement.

[h3]Version 1.0.4[/h3]
[QoL] Added a popup/label in online multiplayer to clearly show when it’s your turn.
[Fix] Stability improvements and minor bug fixes.
[Fix] Improved photo caption readability.
[Fix] Resolved the “DeathZone” achievement.
[Fix] Fixed Mount Everest Crevasse distribution (previously could cause a soft lock).
[Fix] Hid the Wishlist button in the Pause menu.
[Fix] Minor fixes to Polish translations.

notes.title: K2: Digital Edition is a part of Turn-Based Carnival 2024! 🎲
notes.content:
[b]K2: Digital Edition[/b] is joining another exciting edition of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/Acram/sale/Turn-BasedCarnival2024][b]Turn-Based Carnival[/b][/url]!

This event is a tribute to the games that make us think, plan, and savor every move. It's a chance to celebrate the creativity, depth, and diversity of turn-based gameplay. 👇

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/Acram/sale/Turn-BasedCarnival2024][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34953556/96dad9192d8cbcd0dc58b95033113ed9362507dd.png[/img][/url]

But that’s not all!

We have some exciting news to share! Alongside the [b]Turn-Based Carnival[/b], we are proud to announce our first original game - [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2924580/Inkborn/&utm_source=Steam&utm_medium=TBCxInkborne&utm_campaign=Announcement][b]Inkborn[/b][/url], a roguelike deckbuilder that takes players on a dynamic, strategic journey unlike anything you've experienced before. Set to release on [b]Early Access in Q2 2025[/b]! 🖋️

What sets [b]Inkborn[/b] apart? 🃏
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2924580/Inkborn/&utm_source=Steam&utm_medium=TBCxInkborne&utm_campaign=Announcement][b]Inkborn[/b][/url] features an innovative combo system where players discover powerful moves by playing cards in specific sequences, reminiscent of classic fighting game combos but with a unique twist. Our original [b]Origami art style[/b] and evolving roster of character classes make every run feel unique. At launch, players can experiment with [b]over 100 kinds of cards[/b], and we'll be expanding the game with more characters, cards, and features leading up to the [b]Full Release in Q2 2026[/b]. 🎮

notes.title: Do developers sometimes treat players as testers? Our thoughts about testing
notes.content:
We have just released an upgraded demo. We believe we fixed all major issues.

But the first version of the demo was out in December, and we were pretty certain we already had a decent game at that moment. But it had a few problems we didn't even know about.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720765/7273277384e58bab8f2559ce9c8b738f3f180cda.png[/img]

[b]We tested a lot with players to see how well they did. And we think there are a few reasons why we (and sometimes other developers) missed at some points:[/b]

[list]
[*] We have been looking at K2 almost every day since late 2022. We do not see our own mistakes.
[*] Tested people knew they are tested and pay more attention to read popups than regular players (and thus rules were more clear for them)
[*] testers knew we were developers. And people do not want to hurt your fillings and are more friendly than independent reviewers.
[*] too few testers - if you have limited resources, there are always too few testers. And you always missed some issue which are
[*] no time / no money: In software development all projects take twice as long as you assumed. Every single time :) So in a lot of cases you simply do not have money to fix those. Sometimes you already have a release date and you do not have time to work on issues. So you improve after release.
[*] From the user's perspective it always looks like developers are lazy :) We have experience, but every game is different. And it's why we make mistakes in the process. Simple as that. Hope we are at least learning. 
[/list]

[b]Devon Games[/b] is just me and a friend working in our free time. When we realized there is more issues that we expected we simple delayed release date by 2 months (we did not announce it anyway so no damage done)

[b]What have we improved in the demo?[/b]
[list]
[*] We actually rewrote the tutorial. Additionally we create micro tasks to give more context for the user
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720765/e527caeb71df5991fd189792fa3b4de080ecbded.png[/img]
[*] Improved visibility of the board. Rethink which informations are really needed and slightly modify how we present other
[*] added extra information how far is to each space and what the shortest path is  (see screen below)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720765/65b87eddb475e393026367ac63bcc1d41cf0c9a2.png[/img]
[*] tooltips (will be more)
[*] tons of small fixes not worth to enumerate them here
[*] It appears that players love or hate our camera controller. So we add alternative mode (but it is story for completely new devblog)
[/list]

Play a demo and use the Feedback button! 
[b]Let’s create a great adaptation of K2 together.[/b]
